<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sonic Strafe](/Feats.aspx?ID=5541) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=527" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Sonic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=697" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

**Requirements**
You currently have a fly Speed.

</column>

---

You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air. [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) twice. Any creature that is adjacent to you at any point during your movement takes 10d6 sonic damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save against your class DC). On a critical failure, the creature is also [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=66) for 1 hour.
name: Sonic Strafe
requirement: You currently have a fly Speed.
